anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system has generated zero learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning as intended.
Trading system shows zero active trades and zero total profit/loss, indicating a lack of trading activity.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential performance degradation or system instability.
Review and potentially restart AI modules to ensure they are functioning and contributing to trading strategies.
Evaluate trading strategies and system configurations to ensure they are correctly set up to initiate trades.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough investigation of the high CPU load to identify and mitigate the root cause.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Restart or debug the AI system to ensure it is operational and generating trading opportunities.
